description:
The application seeks a minor amendment under S19 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended) by way of variation of condition 12 of listed building consent ref. P2024/1453/LBC dated 07.02.2025:
•	RAISING OF COAL VAULT ENTRANCE DOOR HEIGHT (COMPLIANCE): Notwithstanding references within the Structural Engineer’s Design Intent Report dated May 2024 no permission is granted for the raising of the coal vault entrance door height.
The condition would be varied to read:
6.5	The condition would be varied to reflect this:
•	RAISING OF NORTHERN COAL VAULT ENTRANCE DOOR HEIGHT (COMPLIANCE): Notwithstanding references within the Structural Engineer’s Design Intent Report dated May 2024 permission is granted for the raising of the northern coal vault entrance door where modern lintel already exists.
REASON: For the avoidance of doubt and in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the heritage asset.

decision_conditions:
ALL EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL WORKS TO MATCH (COMPLIANCE):  All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile.  All such works and finishes shall be maintained as such thereafter. 

REASON:  In order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the heritage asset.
